tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rtse gdong chos sde gsang chen smra ba'i gling gi bca' yig bslab bya'i gnang bkag gsal bar ston pa sa steng pad+mo rgyas pa'i nyi 'od phrin las mkha' khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥsaṅgu ru s+ya pā da ya/ rgyal kun yab gcig ngag dbang lha de des gtum tshul sogs sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /'gro ba kun la dga' bzhi'i mchog stsol stsol phyir bsod nams rin chen zhes/ /mtshan bzang bkra shis grags pa mkha' khyab khyab bdag mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i gter/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhas mkhas grub dpal ldan bzang po rgyal/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la rnam grol lam ston ston pa bla med zas gtsang sras/ /nyon mongs dug gsum zug rngu las skyob skyob pa bla med dam pa'i chos/ /bsod nams zhing mchog yid can yongs 'dren 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun te/ /rmad byung yon tan kun gyi mnga' bdag bdag nyid chen po mchog gsum mchod/ /mkhyen pas chos kun mngon sum nyid mkhyen mkhyen rab mtshungs med 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dpal ldan sa skyar lha rigs las sprul sprul pa'i dpal mnga' brtse chen rje/ /rje yi thugs sras rje btsun sku mched mched dbon chos rje rnam gnyis zhabs/ /zhabs pad skye dgu'i gtsug gis nyer mchod mchod 'os gong ma rnam lngar 'dud/ /'dzam bu'i sgra ldan 'dzam gling lho yi byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs/ /ljongs dang ljongs chen yul 'khor gyis gang bod yul lte ba rdo rje'i gdan/ /gdan sa chen po che ba'i yon tan du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal sa skyar/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras mi yi srid bzung rim byon brgyud par bcas rnams bsngags/ /khyad par snyigs dus spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin chen spel ba la/ /'gran zla kun bral bdud kyi stobs 'phrog ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen dang / /'chad rtsod rtsom dang thos bsam sgom la thogs pa mi mnga' 'jam pa'i dbyangs/

/sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams rnam gnyis mchod/ /rdo rje rnon po gtsang ma'i cho rigs ni/ /skabs gsum grong khyer 'od gsal zhes 'bod pa'i/ /gnas nas yul bzung sa mtho stod kyi phyogs/ /mnga' ris kha ba'i sa 'dzin spo la 'phos/ /'ga' dag shes tshwa'i gangs mtshams babs zhes gleng / /lha nyid mi rjer gyur pa g.yu se sogs/ /rim byon spyi dang khyad par snyigs dus mgon/ /sngon tshe dus mchod bla brang pa zhes dang / /phyis dus rtse gdong bla brang par grags pa'i/ /gdung rabs rim par byon pa thams cad la/ /bdag cag snying nas dad pas gsol 'debs na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol/ /he ru ka yi pho nya zhing bcu'i gshed/ /ye shes spyan ldan rdzu 'phrul zhabs mnga' ba'i/ /ma hā kā la lcam dral gdong bzhi pa/ /las mgon lnga sogs dam can rgya mtsho dang / /rnam sras la sogs gter bdag nor lha'i tshogs/ /bstan la dga' ba'i lha srung 'khor bcas kyis/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /bar chad sel la las bzhi'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dkar ba kha ba'i lhun po dang dung gi sa 'dzin mtshan mo'i mgon po'i rjes 'gro'i tshul gyis bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas par bstod cing mchod pa'i me tog man+da ra ba dang ba'i yid kyis mngon par gtor te/ 'dir ched du bya ba ni bla ma mnyam med pa chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas/ 'jigs med stug po bkod pa'i pho brang ltar/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang pos nyer bsten pa/ /gsang chen smra ba du ma'i bsti gnas mchog /blo gros yangs pa'i 'dun sa bsngags par bgyis/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid kyis/ shar ri 'gro ldan gyi gtsug ltar mtho/ /lho na rta mchog rgyug 'dra'i chu/ /nub ri rma bya'i mtshan ma dang ldan/ /byang gi lhun po 'dab bzang lus/ /ri dwags rgyal po bzhad pa'i gdong can/

/dbus kyi sa 'dzin dpal kun 'dzin/ /de phyir rgyal ba'i gdan sa mchog /'di byang chub snying po ma lags sam/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid kyis/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i gdan las byang gi 'dab chags sa yi snying por dpag tshad bcu phrag bcu bgrod par/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis nges pa bstan pas dbyangs can las lhag blo yi dpal ldan sa chen dbus su gser skya bzhin/ /grub pa'i drang srong rnam par rol pa'i dka' thub tshal mchog sdom brtson rnam par rol pa'i 'dun pa dga' ba'i tshal/ /gang gi grags pas dbang po'i yid 'phrog chu srin rgyal mtshan dga' bo 'phrog byed dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ma ga dha rdo rje gdan nas byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i sa gtsang grom pa la stod dpal ldan sa skya bod kyi rdo rje gdan 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams dang mthun par rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa dpyad dang / gzhan yang nyi ma 'char snga zhing nub bul ba/ rgyab ri mtho zhing nye ba/ mdun ri ring zhing dma' ba/ lho nub kyi phyogs gzhol zhing / chu bo g.yas su 'bab pa la sogs pa bkra shis kyi dge mtshan du ma dang ldan zhing / khyad par rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthu las 'dir byon pa'i gdung rabs rnams kyang de dag gi rnam par sprul pa sha stag 'byon pa ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ ma 'ongs 'khon gdung yin nges gang zag rnams/ /nga yi nyan thos rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /grub chen brgyad bcu'i rnam 'phrul ma gtogs pa/ /skal pa dman pa gzhan dag 'byung re skan/ /zhes rgyal ba nyid kyis kyang dbu bsnyung bzhes pa dang / slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ klong gsal mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi lung bstan las/ kun dga' snying po sa skya lo tsā dang / /bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes/

/rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa gtsang du 'byung / /zhes dang / sa skya lo tsā kun dga'i ming / /'phags pa'i mig can gnyis byung nas/ /bod khams sems can bde la bkod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa lnga bcu 'dzin/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin/ /zhes gsung zhing / jo bo rje dpal ldan mar me mdzad bod la byon pa'i skabs su/ 'brong ngu'i rtse nas sa skya'i dpon po ri kha'i ldebs la 'brong gnyis rtswa za ba'i gzigs snang las/ ma 'ongs pa na de'i gnas bdag ma hā kā la gnyis kyis mdzad par lung bstan zhing / phyag 'tshal sgang nas gzigs pas bde mchog pho brang gi nub stod kyi ri la dhīḥyig bdun/ hūm̐ yig gcig hrīḥyig gcig rnams gzigs pas/ de kha nas phyag mchod 'bul bar mdzad pas/ deng sang gi bar du yang phyag 'tshal sgang du grags shing / 'khor rnams kyis dogs gcod zhus pas ma 'ongs pa na 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa bdun/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa gcig phyag rdor gyi sprul pa gcig rnams kyis thog drangs rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam sprul rgyun mi chad du 'byon par lung bstan no/ /de ltar bka' bstan bcos 'khrul zad kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis dgon gnas gdung brgyud bcas gsal bar lung bstan zhing bsngags brjod kyi me tog lan cig min pa yang yang 'thor bar mdzad pa'i dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po nas dbang po'i phyogs su ha cang yang mi ring bar bgrod pa'i sa na gdan sa 'og ma'am rtse gdong bla brang zhes bya ba 'di ni sngon gyi dus su gdan sa chen po'i dus mchod bla brang pa'i gdung rgyud dbang rnam sras rgyal mtshan sogs 'khrul zad gong ma dag gis yang dben mdzad pa'i mu nas sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i yab dbang nam mkha' bkra shis kyis chos grwa chen po srid gsum rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i 'gram bting /

de nas bzung gdung rabs rim par byon pa rnams kyis gdan sa gong gi phyag len dang mthun par sngags phyogs rgyud sde gsar rnying gi chos grwa chen po btsugs te dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ khyad par bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gnyis kyi sku ring la lugs zung gi mdzad 'phrin 'gran bral bstan 'gro'i srog zungs lta bur gyur/ phyis su bdag chen ngag dbang nor bu bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po dang / ngag dbang nor bu rgyal mtshan gyi sku dus nas bzung lnga bdo'i chos nyid spyi sger gdul bya'i las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu dus smin lta bus bdag chen nyid la'ang 'o brgyal sku srog la babs pa lta bu byung zhing / de'i rgyu las 'dzin bdag ya bral gyi mur lo mang rabs zhig 'das pas sde dgon phal cher la'ang nyams chags che ba byung mod rjes su mchog gsum spyi dang bye brag rtse gdong gong ma yab sras rnams kyis thugs bskyed dam bca' brtan pa'i mthu dang ma hā kā la lcam dral gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i nus pa la brten nas/ nged gdan sa pa spun gyi thog rang log byung ba 'di bzhin la da cha 'dir bzhugs dge 'dun rnams nas chos khrims mdzad dgos dbyangs rol cho ga phyag len gar thig phra mo tshun chad rtse gdong rnying dus 'dres med byung na de khas 'thus rgyu yin yang / de ni bar skabs nyams chags che ba'i mthu las ra ma lug sna tshogs zhig tu song 'dug pas/ des na gdan sa gong gi thub bstan lha khang chen mo dang gsang sngags bde chen gling gi chos grwa chen po'i sgrig srol kun spyod bzhin sor bzhag byung na rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs pa las lhad kyi rnam pa spu tsam yang med par mchog gsum dpang bzhag yin pa'i phyir na/ de dang mthun pa'i chos khrims gsar 'dzugs 'di bzhin la/

rtse gdong gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang zhal mi gnyis pa chos dbyings su mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshul bstan pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / bstan 'gro'i bde skyid yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas nas rang cag kun kyang skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnam par dag pa thob nas tshul khrims dang ldan zhing mar gyur 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon du 'gyur ba ni nges pa yang dag pas de'i phyir 'dir bzhugs dge 'dun tshang mas spyod lam mdzad dgos/ legs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba nges 'byung gi bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ pha ma rigs drug gi sems can rnams snying khongs su bcangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas par bya dgos/ de'ang nyes med phun tshogs kyi dbang du mdzad do/ /mdo rtsa ba las/ dge bsnyen nyid dang / dge tshul nyid dang / dge slong nyid dag gis snga ma bsnyen par ma rdzogs par phyi ma mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dus la babs rim gyis so so'i cho ga rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas sdom pa rnams brgyud pa khungs btsun las rim pa bzhin blangs te/ de dag gi bslab bya bla ma slob dpon gyis ji ltar bstan pa bzhin nan tan chen pos sems la dran 'dzin drag po btang nas/ nyes pa phra zhing phra bas kyang mi gos pa'i thabs lus ngag yid gsum rtse gcig tu bsgrims te blang dor gyi gnas la zob pa lhur len pa dang / bslab pa bgres pa'i chos grogs rnams kyis kyang brtse sems drag pos bslab bya dran bskul yang dag mdzad dgos shing / de la gzhon pa rnams kyis gus pa dang bcas te nyan pa gal che/ spyir chos byas pa'i dgos pa sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched kho na yin gyi/ dmyal ba sgrub pa la lus ser mor bsgyur skra dang kha spu bregs pa la don med pas yan lag phra zhing phra ba nas bsrung ma nus na'ang /

srog gcod pa/ ma byin len pa/ 'dod log spyod pa/ brdzun du smra ba ste rtsa ba bzhi dang chang dang lnga po srog la bsdos nas bsrung / gal te sngon las dang 'phral rkyen dbang gis rtsa ba bzhi po gang rung la skyon byung na dge 'dun dang lhan cig tu dad rdzas la longs spyod na rang nyid lcags kyi tho lum me 'bar ba za ba sogs kyi dmyal bar skye dgos par gsung zhing / tshul khrims 'chal ba de'i nyes pa'i shan gyis der bzhugs dge 'dun gzhan la'ang grib phog nas chos kyi yon tan skye ba'i gegs byed pa yin pas/ bstan pa'i mig rgyan la mi gnod cing / rang nyid skye ba gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub pa'i phyir du shin tu bag yod pa gal che/ mi tshangs spyod kyi char gtogs 'khrig tshig tsam yang mi brjod/ ma byin len gyi cha rku ba'i bsam pas nas phul gang du longs pa yang mi brku/ srog gcod kyi char gtogs grog sbur tsam yang mi gsod cing 'tshe ba mi byed/ gzhan byed pa mthong na'ang thabs sna tshogs kyis skyob gang thub mdzad dgos/ rdzun gyi skor mi chos bla ma lta ci smos/ gnas skabs su sde rigs phan tshun/ grwa tshang so so'i gzhan du bsam pa'i phyogs gtam ham lab sogs brdzun gyi char gtogs tsam yang mi smra/ dpon slob grogs mched grwa tshang dkrugs pa'i phra ma mi 'jug rang gzhan gnyis ka la gnod pa'i tshig rtsub kyis zhen pa mi sreg dgos med kyis nyon mongs slong zhing thos bsam gyi bar chad du 'gyur ba'i ngag 'khyal mi smra/ gzhan gyi rdzas longs spyod dbang thang mthong ba la gnas min du bdag gir byed 'dod pa'i brnab sems mi byed/ gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam ngan sbyor rtsub dngos shugs gang yang rung ba sogs gnod sems mi byed/ mtho ba bla ma dkon mchog gsum nas rigs drug gi sems can yan la log lta skad cig kyang ma skyes pa'i spang blang gal che/ gong 'khod kyi nyes pa 'di rnams byas pa ngos zin na mkhan slob dbu chos rnams nas rgan gzhon kha drag zhan/

yul gnyen mi gnyen su yin kyang rung / yul de dag la phan pa'i ched du nye ring ngo dga' 'jig rten ngos kyi yas 'jog chos dang mi mthun pa'i skyabs khab spangs te nyes pa byas pa shes 'phral brgya phyag 'gel/ phyag 'tshal mkhan gyis kyang nyes pa la 'gyod tshangs shes pa'i sgo nas rang dang pha ma rigs drug gi sems can rnams lus zhing rdul dang mnyam par mos nas rang gis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi phyag 'tshal bar bsam zhing / chos khrims pas tshad ma bzung gi bar la mthil lnga sa la phab pa'i phyag 'tshal/ lce bye ba brgyar dmigs nas ngag gis kyang sdig bshags brjod/ yid kyis phyin chad srog la babs kyang sdig pa'i las mi byed snyam pa'i sdom sems drag po dang bcas pa byed/ lus ngag gi thad nas blos ma longs kyi rnam 'gyur byas pa byung na nyes pa shin tu lci ba yin pas brgya phyag gsum bldab dang dkon mchog gi drung du dkar me mar nyag lnga 'bul dgos/ grwa tshang dkrugs pa bsam ngan dug sbyor bslab tshul 'chal pa sogs byung na mkhan slob dbu chos rnams kyis gdan sa gong du nged la dag ster 'pher gyin lon thongs pa gyis/ de rigs la hor khrims sogs kyi tsa ra byed pa rang phan pa yin/ bcas ldan rnams kyi 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas las log par bgyi'o/ /zhes khas blangs pa yin pas ngan 'gro sgrub pa'i rtsa ba thar lam gyi gegs bag med nyes pa thams cad skyed pa'i rgyu chang yin pas ngo lkog gang du'ang spong / 'on kyang lo gsar pa rtsi 'grems pa lud skyel sogs la mi nag la dgos pa'i mgron chang phran bu dang / nad la phan nges kyi sman phran bu ma gtogs chang 'grim pa'i rgyun gcod dgos/ gal te 'grim pa byung na tshod re la mar khal re dang de bzhin chang mang nyung la dpag pa'i chad pa chos khrims pas blangs nas spyi pa la sprod la dge 'dun rnams kyi ja rdor la phan pa gyis/

gzhan yang lo re lo thog 'joms pa/ sho mig mangs/ rdo skor/ mda' rtsed/ tshong sogs mdzad pa mi 'os pa byas byung na gong bzhin brgya phyag 'gel/ nad la phan pa'i phyir du 'du dgos byung na ma gtogs mang po 'tshogs tshe ngag la brtag ces gsungs pa ltar/ ngag gi nyes pa la dran shes bzhin bsten dgos pa rang rang gi grong khang dang bla ye sogs pa lkag lkog tu gnyis gsum nas mang du tshogs te don med bag phebs phebs kyi cal col smras na 'dod chags chu ltar g.yo/ zhe sdang me ltar 'bar/ phrag dog sogs rlung ltar du 'tshubs nas rang dbang med par phyogs cha sde rigs grwa tshang phan tshun rang rang gi bla ma'i zhen phu rus su bsam ste skyes bu dam pa rnams dang dge 'dun gyi sde la ris su bcad nas skur pa 'debs pa sogs mnar med du skye nges pa'i las gsog rang rang gi mched grogs phan tshun gyi gnas lugs brjod par bsams nas skyon brjod gleng pas 'khrug slong gi rgyu byed pa sogs nyes pa mtha' yas zhig 'byung zhing / bdud dang po ngag la 'jug ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'byung po stobs chen gyi bar chad dang po ngag la 'jug pa yin pas tshe 'di'i snang ba bde bde bag phebs phebs la brten nas bdud kyis sems rgyud bslad/ de la brten nas dpon slob grogs mched phan tshun gcom zol du 'gro ba dang / chos 'chad nyan slob gnyer rim gro sgrig sogs las g.yel du song nas 'thab rtsod snyung gzhi sogs mi dge ba 'byung nges yin pas de bzhin du ma song bar rang rang gi gnas su sems rnal du phob/ blo bla ma dkon mchog la lings bkal nas zon che bar mdzad pa gal che/ gong 'khod rnams la chos khrims pas lta rtogs 'phral 'phral byas nas rgyu mtshan zhib dpyod kyi legs nyes brtag tshogs nam 'tshogs dus dge 'dun 'du ba'i brda dung 'khar rnga brda rnga sogs byung 'phral brtson 'grus bskyed de phyi bshol med par cig car du 'dus ngos/

rtse zhwa mthang sham sogs rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa byed ma gtogs/ 'os min gyi tshos mdog skya bo/ skya thul/ rdo bem/ 'bar zhwa/ dom ra/ zon pa gyon pa sogs ser khyim gyi cha lugs spras pa rnams 'tshogs la mi gtong / sked par gri myug shubs gong pag sogs mi 'dzer/ rgyun bar gyi mang jar chos spyod gtong rim/ tshogs 'phral skyabs 'gro bzhi bskor bdun sogs grangs gang 'os/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gdangs yod med gang rigs/ tshad med bzhi/ rnam dag chos dbyings sogs/ ma lus sems can sogs/ phyogs dus kun nas sogs/ bcom ldan thugs rje sogs gdangs bcas/ rin chen sems de ma yongs rdzogs la lus dang de bzhin sogs gdangs bcas gsum/ deng dus bdag tshe nas lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis bar/ byang chub sems mchog nas/ sems can rnams la de 'byor shog gi bar/ ja mchod skal bzang ma gdangs bcas/ ja rgyab la dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs/ thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sogs/ thub bstod sems brtse ma gdangs ma kha skong thob kyi ma bshur ma'i mjug tu de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku sogs/ khyed la bstod cing sogs/ byams pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs byams pa'i mtshan brgya dpa' bo chen po ma dang bstod pa chags pa'i skyon bral ma gnyis re mos/ gang tshe mi pham 'gro ba'i don gzigs nas sogs/ gang gi blo gros sogs/ mtshan brjod gtong na gzhon nu sku lus sogs dang / de min gang blo ma'i mjug tu brtse ldan khyod kyi sogs/ lo bstod rgyal ba'i mdun na ma/ zhi ba gdong bzhi ma gdangs ma/ chos rgyal mes dbon rnams gsum sogs kyi bstod pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i bstod pa gsum re mos/ dkon mchog rgyal po'i bstod pa rigs rus cho 'brang / zhang ston gyi bstod pa yon tan mchog mnga' ma/ gong ma lnga bstod la tshangs spyod ma dang khyod nyid ma re mos/ chos rgyal ma'i mjug tu de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i zhing sogs/

chos rje bla ma theg chen chos rje/ g.yag rong rnam gnyis kyi sku bstod rnams sh+lau ka re/ ngor chen gyi bstod pa rab sde rba gsum re mos/ rong ston gyi bstod pa gsung rab rgya mtsho ma/ g.yag pa'i bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan nyi ma/ sems dpa' chen po'i bstod pa rin chen dkon mchog ma dang thub bstan gser khang ma gnyis re mos/ kun mkhyen gyi bstod pa rgya chen ma'i mjug bsod nams ye shes ma sbyar ba/ yongs 'dzin gyi bstod pa dkon mchog gsum dngos ma/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan pa legs 'dzin ma/ dbang nam mkha' bkra shis kyi sku bstod mkhyen pa nam mkha' ma/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku bstod rab mdzes ma/ zab yangs ma/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma/ gang gi zhabs brtan ma rnams re mos/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug gi bstod pa dus gsum rgyal ba ma'i mthar nyes pas ma gos ma sbyar ba/ 'jam dpal grags pa'i sku bstod mi pham byams mgon ma/ bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub kyi sku bstod yongs 'dzin dam pa ma'i mjug tu dngos grub 'byung ma sbyar ba/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku bstod shes bya kun la ma dang byin brlabs char 'bebs ma re mos/ kun dga' bde legs kyi sku bstod kun nas dad sems ma'i mthar rig pa'i gnas lnga ma mthud pa/ yang de'i sku bstod brtse chen kun dga' ma/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i sku bstod rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma/ 'dzam gling che dgu ma/ byams pa'i mnga' bdag ma/ phun tshogs tshul khrims ma rnams re mos/ kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyi sku bstod kun dga'i legs bshad ma/ dpal ldan kun dga' ma'i mthar legs brgyas ma'i smon lam sbyar ba/ yang de'i bstod pa thar lam gsal ba'i mig 'byed/ yang byams brtse ma rgyal sras ngag dbang ma rnams re mos/

'jig rten rgya hor gyi sku bstod mtha' yas 'gro la ma/ bsod nams bstan 'dzin dbang po'i sku bstod bsod nams brgyas bskrun ma dang / dpal ldan byang chub ma'i mthar byams pa'i thugs rje ma dang nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ma sbyar ba/ bsod nams ye shes ma le tshan gnyis/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma rnams re mos/ ngag dbang nor bu bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po'i zhabs brtan ngag dbang lha rigs ma bsod nams bstan 'dzin dbang pos mdzad pa la kho bos gsol 'debs su bsgyur ba/ kun dga' tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang ngag dbang nor bu rgyal mtshan gyi sku bstod gnyis kho bos brtsams pa rnams dang / yang skabs 'gar sa lo'i sku bstod rnams kyi mthar zhabs drung ngag nas kyi sku bstod dus gsum rgyal ba ma/ tshe nas kyi sku bstod rigs gsum rnam 'phrul ma gnyis sh+lau ka re/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sku bstod/ dkon mchog gsum dngos ma/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po dang 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i sku bstod gang du bshad pa'i le tshan rnams gang rigs/ grags blo ba'i sku bstod 'gro ba'i mgon po ma/ legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma/ sngags 'chang bstan nyi ma rnams re mos/ grags pa'i mkha' khyab ma/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug ma/ grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs sgra chen/ ngag gi dbang po dang grags pa'i mtshan can sogs sku 'bring gi sku bstod rnams sh+lau ka re/ de ltar rtse gcig sogs sh+lau ka gcig sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma rgyal ba gnyis pa ma ste mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi sku bstod mjug bdag gi dus gsum ma sbyar ba/ sngon tshe chos kyi rgyal po tshul khrims 'bar sogs spyan snga kun dga' don grub dang / mdo rgyud man ngag sogs mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi sku bstod gnyis sh+lau ka re re/ sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku bstod 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma'i mjug rigs sras bsod nams dbang phyug gi zhabs brtan lha mchog ngag gi dbang phyug sogs dang rigs sras myur byon gyi gsol 'debs ngag dbang lha yi ti la ka las 'khrungs sogs sbyar ba/

ngag dbang lha yi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzugs sogs kyi sku bstod rigs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gi sku bstod rgyal ba gnyis pa ma'i mjug lha mchog ngag dbang ma sbyar ba/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyi sku bstod 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dang bslu med bla ma smon lam ma sbyar ba gnyis re mos/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku bstod le tshan gnyis re mos/ brgyud 'debs rnam dag dkyil 'khor ma dang / dpal mchog ma gnyis re mos/ bzang spyod/ byams smon/ mi mjed ma/ 'gro la bde skyid ma smon lam/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad bcas gtong rgyu la mang ja mang nyung babs gzigs ngos/ chos spyod kyi rim pa 'os mtshams btang ba'i dngos gzhi gang bkod tshang ma la chad lhag med pa zhig dgos rgyu yin pas dbu byed kyis 'os babs lta ba gal che zhing / sbyin bdag shi gson gyi don du mang ja byung na 'dod sbyar bzhin gyi chos spyod dang / tshes bcu byung ngo cog la sa lo'i dus chen bla mchod la brgyud 'debs rnam dag ma/ gong bstod sogs 'os 'tshams/ sa lo'i sku bstod bzhi ka yongs rdzogs bcas/ mang jar 'du skabs rang rang gi grwa khang nas tshogs su ma 'grig bar ri khrod ma'i gzungs 'don/ tshogs gyes nas grwa khang so sor ma byon bar yang ri khrod ma'i gzungs 'don/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi gnam gang la kun rig dril thogs byung tshe phyag cha sogs chad lhag med pa/ zla re bzhin nyer dgu'i dus gtor deb zur gsal dang / slar rim gyis tshugs rgyur rgyun 'don/ rnal 'byor ma gnyis/ slob dpon dbu chos sogs kyi gdong du rgyugs pher gyi rigs nas gtong tshul deb zur gsal bzhin la/ rnal 'byor mar rdor dril/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ dung chos sogs tshang ma/ gzhan bde kyai gsang gsum phur pa/

gtor bzlog gnyis rnams 'dzugs rgyu la/ gtong tshul phyag cha sogs deb nang bzhin la sla bcos su ma song ba'i thag pa khur blangs dang / dbyangs rol tshig dang gar thig phra mo tshun chad slob dpon mkhas par yang dag gtugs pa'i chig skya pher nges byung na dang / de min yang bstan pa'i mig rgyan la mi gnod pa zhig dgos rgyu yin pa so so nas nges pa dang / sgrig la zhugs nas 'dzin chos kyi rim par phyi mo klog pa sngon 'gro'i gang 'khod chos spyod tshang ma rgyugs pher dang / de rjes phur chung gtor bsngo/ bskang ba thugs dam ma yongs rdzogs/ bstod pa rngam 'bar/ rab 'bar gnyis dang / dbang yangs blo rno ba rnams kyis dgos bskang bstod rnying yongs rdzogs bcas cig car dgos rgyu dang / dbang rtul gyi rigs nas dgos bskang bstod rnying yongs rdzogs rim pas bslab sbyong mthar phyin nas rtsa brgyud brtag gnyis/ bde kyai gsang gsum/ phur pa/ kun rig rnal 'byor ma/ gtor bzlog gnyis rnams 'dir bris pa'i gral rim bzhin nam/ gtor bzlog gnyis ma gtogs gzhan rnams snga phyi gang 'os blo gros dang bstun pa'i sbyong brdar yang dag mdzad rgyu dang / bsnyen pa'i rim pa'ang kyai rdor gzhi bsnyen/ rdo rje phur pa/ mgon po'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg bcas phal cher nas byung na legs shing / gal te gzhan gnyis la thub tshe/ dges rdor gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin zhig med kha med la so so nas mdzad pa dang gzhan yang bde mchog kun rig rnal 'byor ma sogs sa skya'i gong ma'i bka' srol 'dres med phyag len thub na shin tu legs pas de bzhin dang / bsnyen pa mthar phyin rim nas gson dge gshin chog la 'byon rgyur so so'i 'dod sbyar bzhin rnam 'joms/ sme brtsegs sogs khrus rigs dang / seṅge sgra/ chab klu/ bsangs/ bskang gso/ tshe chog kun rig mdo rgyud bklag pa sogs shi gson la phan nges pa lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas sgrub pa'i nyin mo mthar phyin par byas pa'i mtshan mo khyim khrod du mi gnas pa dang /

chos mtshams so so la gzhis yul du 'byon dgos thag ring bar zla phyed dang / nye bar zhag bcu bzhugs pa'i spyod lam bag yangs su ma song ba dgos rgyu dang / gzhan mchod gnas thag ring par 'byon dgos rnams mkhan slob dbu chos la zhus pa'i zhag grangs yun ring thung sogs khong rnams kyi ngag bzhin byed pa dang don gnyer gyi chos zhu 'dod rnams rje btsun gong ma'i bka' srol lhad med 'dzin pa'i gdan sa gong / e waṃ chos ldan/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan sogs dang gang mos kyi dgon gnas nye ring na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / 'di kha chos sde'i mkhan slob nas bstan rgyun la phan pa'i chos 'chad rnam dag byung na der gtugs lugs mdzad rgyu dang / phyogs 'byon gyi rigs la las tshan rnams la dgongs pa zhus pa'i zhag yun ring thung sogs mdzad rgyu dang / ban tshang ba rnams 'don cha bsgrigs rim kun spyod mdzad tshul spyir btang bca' yig 'di bzhin dang / dmigs bsal tho zur bkod bzhin ma 'chug pa dgos rgyu lags shing / mdor na rnga rol dkrol lugs/ gral la 'dug tshul sogs phra zhing phra ba mtha' dag gdan sa chen po'i phyag len rnam dag mig mthong yid gsal bzhin dang / slob dpon mkhas pa'i ngag rgyun la nyan pa dang / gong ma so so kho bo bcas nas logs su bkod pa'i deb tho zur 'debs rnams la gtugs shing dpyad pa'i ngos/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che sa phyogs 'dir nam langs nyi shar lta bu zhig dgos rgyu la bca' yig 'di'i do dam par mkhan slob dbu chos rnams kyis mdzad dgos rgyur/ phyogs cha nye ring ngo dkar nag drag zhan bltas pa sogs byung na chos sde spyi nas gnas tshul 'khyol bar gyis/ bden rdzun gyi shan dang mchog gsum dpang bzhag 'di ga nas dpyad pas nyes pa su yin gyi steng du chad pa 'gel lugs byed dgos bcas phra rags thams cad mchog gsum dpang bzhag rang gzhan gyi 'di phyi bsam pa'i mdzad sgo mtho ba mkhan slob dbu chos nas bzung dma' ba blo gsar rnams bcas so so'i thugs yul du bcangs pa'i rang cag dpon slob nyin mtshan phyogs dus kun tu rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed gzhung 'khrul med dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston khyad par can la dges par longs spyod chog pa zhig cis kyang mkhyen zhu/

shrī ma hā kā la/ ma hā kā lī de wi tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra ye na maḥ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ yum chen e ka dza ṭī/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ stobs 'phrog rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ sha za srin mo mched bzhi/ nor skyong dur khrod bdag po/ ber nag zangs gri can/ gcer bu dur khrod kyi bdag po/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' bstod pu tra ming sring / bran bdud gshin rje nag po/ gdong bsnyen sgo ma rnam bzhi/ 'bar ba gaṇ+ḍe'i khro tshogs/ dkar bdud lcam dral/ phur bsrung dam can bcu gnyis/ bka' 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa ye shes gsal ba'i spyan dang ldan zhing / rdzu 'khrul myur ba'i zhabs dang ldan pa/ thugs rje tshad med pa'i mthu stobs mnga' ba/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi bar chad sel zhing phrin las mdzad par mthu thogs pa med par chos sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mi nor rdzas gsum gyi srung ma/ dam nyams sdig can rnams lo zla ma 'gyangs par/ srog dbugs zhal du bzhes pa'i dam bca' dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis rdo rje 'chang chen po nas bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bar byon pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa spyi dang / bye brag sngags 'chang bdud kyi stobs 'phrog ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ste 'gran bral gyi skyes chen zhal rnam pa gnyis kyi bka' dang dam tshig las ma 'da' bar/

spyir gyi bstan pa de 'dzin dge 'dun gyi sde so so bcas dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su bde legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ bye brag tu yangs pa'i phyogs 'di nyid du sa skya'i rje btsun dbang po'i grangs ldan gyi bka' srol/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras khu dbon rnams kyi phyag len gyi rgyun bzang po gsang sngags kyi chos grwa rtse gdong chos kyi sde gsang chen smra ba'i gling du bdag gis lhag bsam dag cing sbyor ba gus pa'i sgo nas gsar 'dzugs bgyis pa 'di la 'dir bzhugs dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba yi ge 'bri spyod sbyin pa gtong ba la sogs pa chos spyod rnam pa bcu dang / khyad par gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde zab mos smin grol thugs nyams bstar te bca' yig 'di'i don bzhin phyag len du 'debs par mdzad pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor 'khor dang longs spyod lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas te/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bzhed gzhung 'khrul med gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i chos tshul mtha' dag rab tu rgyas shing yun du gnas par mdzad du gsol/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dgon gnas sde dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gzugs med kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag gi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mi nus pa'i dgon gnas sde dang bcas pa la nad rims gtong ba sogs ngan sdig byed pa'i gzugs med rnams dang / gzugs can bca' yig 'di dang bla ma gong ma ye shes spyan ldan rnams khyad du bsad cing / chos srung rnams la brnyas pa/

chos mthun gyi gang zag bdag cag dpon slob gong ma'i ring lugs skyong bar khas 'che ba rnams la do bsdo ba/ phod 'dzugs pa/ bsam sbyor ngan pa 'chang ba'i byad ma thams cad srung skyob byed pa'i lha dang / rgyab rten dpung grogs gnyen bshes mdza' ba'i grogs dang phyes/ tshe'i 'du byed skums/ gnam kyi 'ju thag chod/ sa'i rten phur phyung / snying khrag thang la phos/ rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod/ yul dang khang khyim shig ye shes kyis mes sregs/ dus kyi rlung gis gtor te/ mdor na dam nyams dgra bgegs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig thang gcig yud tsam la til 'bru tsam yang med pa'i phrin las kun gyi mngon du de ma thag thong la phyin chad sa'i phyogs 'dir bdud dang bdud rigs su gtogs pa'i skye ba'i rgyu 'khrul skad cig kyang med par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob mar gyur 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob ste slar yang gang 'dul sprul pas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i rgyur gyur cig ces rtse gdong chos sde gsang chen smra ba'i gling gi bca' yig bslab bya'i gnang bkag gsal bar ston pa sa bstan pad+mo rgyas pa'i nyi 'od 'phrin las mkha' khyab ces bya ba 'di ni sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas/ gdan sa 'og gam smon mkhar ram stag tshang ngam rtse gdong la sogs pa ming gi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa 'di nyid du sngon sa skya'i gdung brgyud na rim gyis bskyang shing rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed srol kha gtsang yin pa la/ bar skabs zhig tu nyams chag che ba byung mod kyang rjes su gdan sa gong nas skyong chog pa'i lung bzang gong bzhugs rnams kyis bka' drin bstsal ba bzhin/ nged rang chung ngu lo bcu dgu'i steng 'di phyogs su yongs skabs lha sde mi sde rnam pa bstan la dad gus che yang gong ma'i bka'
